title: Login
description: Email + password sign-in, forgot-password link, invite-code entry, and tour CTA. Default screen for unauthenticated users.

title: Forgot Password
description: Email input; always shows a non-committal success message (no account enumeration).

title: Invite Redeem
description: Account creation with an invite code.

title: Dashboard
description: Overview hub: Daily Habits completion ring, Wellbeing card (Morning/Evening/Health), Tasks and Journal cards, pinned routines, pinned goals, activity heatmap.

title: Wellbeing Overview
description: Today's check-in status (Morning/Evening/Sleep), 7-day trends, quick actions. Opened from the Wellbeing card chevron.

title: Morning Check-in
description: "How do I feel right now?" — 5-point sliders (Mood, Energy, Anxiety, Motivation, Focus), notes, and Medications Taken Today.

title: Evening Check-in
description: "How did today go?" — 5-point sliders (Satisfaction, Productivity, Mood, Stress, Enjoyment), reflection, day-impact tags.

title: Health Hub
description: Entry points for Sleep, Medications, Supplements, Symptoms, Weight, and Caffeine logging.

title: Log Sleep
description: Apple Watch sleep score + sub-scores, bedtime/wake pickers, duration, quality, last-night habit toggles, "Night of" date picker.

title: Medication Manager
description: Add/edit/delete medications (dose, schedule), toggle active. Seeded with Loratadine 10mg.

title: Supplement Manager
description: User-defined supplements (dose, schedule) + today's taken/not-taken toggle. Seeded with Vitamin D3 and Magnesium glycinate.

title: Symptom Manager
description: User-defined symptoms + today's 1–5 severity log. Seeded with Headache.

title: Weight Log
description: Generic once-per-day numeric health factor logger (lbs).

title: Caffeine Log
description: Additive caffeine logger with quick-add presets (Coffee 95mg, Espresso 63mg, Tea 47mg, Soda 40mg).

title: AI Hub
description: Wellbeing Summary, Weekly Review, and Journal Insights cards. Without a Gemini key each card shows the latest archived report inline (seeded sample reports).

title: AI Report History
description: Browse/open/delete archived AI reports of one kind.

title: Settings
description: Preferences, API keys, notifications, data management, archived habits, and the "How HabitFlow works" tutorial entry.

title: How HabitFlow Works — Basics
description: User-facing reference for habit tracking types and core concepts.

title: How HabitFlow Works — Advanced
description: Goal types, bundles, and advanced behaviors.

title: How HabitFlow Works — AI
description: AI features reference (BYOK Gemini).

title: Archived Habits
description: Restore or permanently delete archived habits; archive preserves entry history.

title: User Menu
description: Display name, hide/show streaks, analytics (beta), sign out / exit demo.

title: Tracker Grid — Health
description: Habit grid with day columns. Shows a boolean habit (Morning walk), numeric habit with target (Drink water, 8 glasses), and the Wind-Down Checklist bundle.

title: Checklist Bundle
description: Wind-Down Checklist bundle with child habits (No screens after 10pm, Evening stretch). Bundle completes when its success rule is met.

title: Tracker Grid — Fitness
description: Weekly-frequency habits (Run 3×/week, Strength training 3×/week) and the Daily Movement choice bundle.

title: Choice Bundle
description: Daily Movement choice bundle — "Pick one" of Yoga session / Bike ride / Swim satisfies the habit for the day.

title: Tracker Grid — Mind
description: Daily boolean habits (Read 20 minutes, Meditate) with streak display.

title: Tracker Grid — Productivity
description: Deep work block: numeric habit (target 3 hours) scheduled on weekdays only (assigned days).

title: Numeric Entry Popover
description: Tapping a numeric habit opens quantity entry with quick-select chips and save/clear actions.

title: Habit History
description: Scrollable month calendar with entry markers plus per-date entry list; select a date to edit/create entries.

title: Edit Habit — Numeric
description: Add/Edit Habit modal in edit mode for a numeric habit: name, target value + unit, frequency, schedule, category, goal links.

title: Category Picker
description: Move a habit to a different category.

title: Bundle Picker
description: Select an existing bundle to add this habit to.

title: Add Habit — Regular
description: Habit creation: Regular Habit vs Habit Bundle toggle, name, goal type (boolean/numeric), schedule & streak options, category, reminder.

title: Add Habit — Bundle Modes
description: Bundle creation: Checklist ("do multiple items") vs Choice ("any one option satisfies") with sub-habit management.

title: Today View
description: Single-day view grouped by category with per-habit completion state.

title: Schedule (Weekly) View
description: Week-at-a-glance overview of scheduled habits.

title: Routines List
description: Routine cards grouped by category; expanding a card reveals variants, start, edit, and delete.

title: Routine Card Expanded
description: Morning Kickstart expanded: Quick and Standard variants with step counts and estimated durations.

title: Routine Preview
description: Read-only step list with timers and linked habits before starting the run.

title: Routine Runner
description: Step-by-step execution: instructions, timer (countdown/stopwatch), linked habit logging, next/previous/skip.

title: Routine Editor
description: Title, category, image, variant tabs, step list with summary badges, and "Suggest with AI" (in demo: pre-authored drafts).

title: Step Editor Panel
description: Per-step editing: title, instructions, timer mode, linked habit chips, image, tracking fields.

title: Goals — All (Collapsed)
description: Collapsible category stacks with goal counts. "New Track" and "+" create actions in header.

title: Goals — All (Fitness Expanded)
description: Fitness stack expanded: goal cards with progress bars plus the Distance Milestones track.

title: Goals — Schedule
description: Insight calendar with deadline/forecast/milestone event dots, category filter, and date detail panel.

title: Goals — Achievements
description: Three-section gallery: Single wins, Progressive iteration chains with milestone nodes, and Track rows with locked stubs.

title: Goal Detail — Cumulative
description: Cumulative goal with milestone markers: progress charts, entry list, linked habits, deadline forecast.

title: Goal Detail — One-time (Completed)
description: A completed one-time goal (Finish a 10K race).

title: Goal Track Detail
description: Ordered stage goals (Run 40 → 80 → 150 miles) with per-stage states and progress.

title: Create Goal — Cumulative
description: Step 1: title, Cumulative/One-time type, milestone rows + final target, unit, deadline, category.

title: Create Goal — One-time
description: One-time goal variant: title, event date, category.

title: Edit Goal
description: Modify goal title, milestones, target, deadline, and linked habits.

title: Create Goal Track
description: Create an ordered track of staged goals.

title: Delete Goal Confirmation
description: Soft-delete confirmation dialog from the goal detail page.

title: Journal — Free Write
description: Freeform journal entry editor.

title: Journal — Templates
description: Template-based guided journaling.

title: Journal — History
description: Past entries list (seeded with ~10 entries).

title: Journal — AI Review
description: AI journal insights (seeded sample report shown inline in demo).

title: Tasks
description: Today and Inbox columns with inline rename, complete, move, and delete actions.

title: Insights — AI Review
description: Gemini narrative over wellbeing data (seeded sample shown in demo).

title: Insights — Overview
description: Discoveries, top correlations, metric averages, heatmap/weekly/multiples.

title: Insights — Correlations
description: What's helping / what's holding you back (Cohen's d cross-domain correlations).

title: Insights — Habits
description: Habit stats and habit↔wellbeing correlations.

title: Insights — Medications
description: Adherence and medication↔wellbeing correlations.

title: Insights — Predictions
description: Linear-trend projections.

title: Analytics — Habits
description: Habit completion statistics and trends.

title: Analytics — Routines
description: Routine completion history and stats.

title: Analytics — Goals
description: Goal progress analytics.

title: Analytics — Sleep
description: Sleep score, consistency, bedtime/wake trends, correlation factors, weekly summary, "Edit a night" list.

title: Roadmap
description: Future functionality with status chips (In Development / Planned / Exploring); shipped features never appear here.

title: Take a Tour
description: Guided walkthrough pairing narrative panels with a live read-only preview of the real app.
